expected.report:
(A) Rectum polyp
(B) Sigmoid polyp

(A)  Sections show a polypoid piece of large intestinal mucosa featuring hyperplastic crypts with stellate-shaped lumina, in keeping with hyperplastic polyp. There is no evidence of dysplasia or malignancy.

(B)  Sections show a polypoid piece of large intestinal mucosa featuring tubular crypts with low grade dysplasia. There is no evidence of invasive malignancy.

(A) Rectum, Rectum polyp, polypectomy - Hyperplastic polyp.
(B) Sigmoid, Sigmoid polyp, polypectomy - Tubular adenoma with low grade dysplasia.
